findings.claim: The field requirement_or_topic_ids promises two reference domains, but validate_design accepts only interview topic IDs and receives no requirement collection. A proposal linked directly to a PRD requirement therefore fails with DANGLING_REFERENCE despite following the field's advertised meaning. Rename the field to topic_ids and document the restriction, or explicitly resolve both domains; the current name conceals this behavioral limitation from document authors and maintainers.

findings.claim: A material open topic can bypass completion and human scope authority simply by setting applicable=false while retaining status=OPEN. Coverage is required only for applicable topics, and human authority is checked only for NOT_APPLICABLE. Consequently an unfinished interview can validate as COMPLETE and satisfy the PRD READY gate. Require consistent applicability/status and authority for excluding any material topic.

findings.claim: Follow-up resolution compares topic IDs but never question dimensions. Two questions under the same topic can address different dimensions, yet an ANSWERED successor resolves an unrelated INCOMPLETE question. Add a negative test with matching topic IDs and different dimensions, and enforce the dimension relationship before accepting resolution.
